metadata.description: One-time AzBrief v2 infrastructure. Foundation and completion are internal orchestration stages; application containers and Agent versions are excluded.
Read-only Portal validation result. The guarded CLI validates before submitting; false always blocks deployment.
Portal input views require the generated server-side policy before any resource write. CLI retains its guarded preflight.
Allow-listed non-secret Portal observations. Never include credentials or raw error bodies.
Separately evaluated non-secret ARM observations; independent of ordinary input changes.

Infrastructure region, independent of model selection and RG metadata. Existing VNet uses its actual region; same-account model deployments inherit their parent Foundry region, not a model-only location.
Use the official Basic VNet Capability Host with no customer agent-data connections. Existing BYO installs must retain false.

Explicit initial Foundry inbound allow-list: publicIpRanges and existing subnetResourceIds. Empty retains private-only access. New managed-data accounts only; outbound injection and private Storage/MCP remain unchanged.
Simple model version; empty uses modelVersion for legacy-compatible deployment.
Optional preapproved setup-only identity/subnet/file-storage ARM IDs. Empty retains the legacy authorized CLI step. No directory permissions or setup networking are created.
